:::{#def-smooth-function}
#### Smooth function (infinitely differentiable function)

A real-valued function $f$ of one variable is **smooth** on an [open interval](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-open-interval) $I$,
also called **infinitely differentiable** on $I$,
if it has a derivative of every order at every point of $I$:
$f'$ (@def-derivative) exists on $I$,
$f''$ (@def-second-derivative) exists on $I$,
and so on, each derivative being differentiable (@def-differentiable) on $I$
[@wikipedia_smoothness].

:::
